facts.fact: The communications minister said Ghana has 13 designated Critical Information Infrastructure sectors and about 200 institutions identified as CII Owners, and that compliance is mandatory; event date not stated, published date used.

The Cyber Security Authority is stated to hold a regulatory and enforcement mandate and ran a workshop on critical information infrastructure in Accra; published date used as event date is not stated.
